summary: PR 7454 fixed several CI README-generation problems and applied related module fixes. It merged on 2026-10-03 after one approval.
proposed: The PR body lists a regex bug where `a: 'a.b'` was detected as an object reference (affecting operational-insights/workspace and its quota parameter), an issue with RPC batches, missing handling of renamed files in the Git-Diff function, and cross-reference logic that broke when ptn modules shared a name with res modules.
changed: The body describes fixing the regex, RPC-batch handling and cross-reference logic, adding support for `R` (moved/renamed) files in the Git-Diff function, correcting diverse folder paths, and deprecating dev-test-labs/lab/secret because the API no longer supports it. The author ran Set-AVMModule recursively over all modules with no further suggested changes.
shipped: Merged 2026-10-03 as commit 574f7d7. Feature deltas show README and CHANGELOG changes in modules including db-for-my-sql/flexible-server (advanced-threat-protection renamed to advanced-threat-protection-setting), dev-test-lab/lab, devices/iot-hub, and two ptn modules.
